definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when making a request or asking someone to do something.
Used when ordering at a restaurant or shop.

examples.japanese: {手伝|てつだ}いをお{願|ねが}いします。
よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. / Thank you in advance.

examples.japanese: {静|しず}かにお{願|ねが}いします。{会議|かいぎ}{中|ちゅう}です。
examples.english: Please be quiet. We're in a meeting.

examples.japanese: お{返事|へんじ}は{今週中|こんしゅうちゅう}にお{願|ねが}いします。{早|はや}めにいただけると{助|たす}かります。
examples.english: Please reply by the end of this week. It would help if you could respond soon.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}をお{願|ねが}いします。
コーヒーをお{願|ねが}いします。
これをお{願|ねが}いします。
{定食|ていしょく}を{一|ひと}つお{願|ねが}いします。
すみません、お{会計|かいけい}をお{願|ねが}いします。{今日|きょう}はとてもおいしかったです。
examples.english: Excuse me, the check please. Today's food was delicious.

notes:
お{願|ねが}いします is one of the most essential polite expressions in Japanese, literally meaning 'I make a request' (from {願|ねが}う, to wish/request).

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- お{願|ねが}い: casual (among friends)
- お{願|ねが}いします: polite (standard)
- お{願|ねが}いいたします: humble/formal (business)
- お{願|ねが}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます: very formal (written)

COMMON SET PHRASES:
- よろしくお{願|ねが}いします: please treat me well (greetings, requests)
- ご{確認|かくにん}をお{願|ねが}いします: please confirm
- ご{協力|きょうりょく}をお{願|ねが}いします: please cooperate

USAGE:
When ordering, use [item]をお{願|ねが}いします. When requesting actions, the request is implied from context. Often used standalone as a polite closer to any request.
